security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:8000; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Understand medical forms and paperwork in plain language.
bundle.longDescription: Photograph a medical form, bill or letter and get a plain-language explanation beside the original, read aloud if you like, with accessibility settings for low vision, dyslexia, motion sensitivity and one-handed use. Not medical advice.
